create_feedback_row: create a FeedbackRow instance with feedback_id, run_id, thread_id, user_id, rating, and optional comment
define_feedback_table: define a SQLAlchemy ORM model mapping to the feedback table with columns for run_id, thread_id, user_id, rating, comment
query_feedback_by_run: query FeedbackRow records filtered by run_id to retrieve all feedback for a specific run
enforce_unique_feedback: enforce a unique constraint on thread_id, run_id, and user_id to prevent duplicate feedback entries
store_thumbs_up_down: store a thumbs-up or thumbs-down rating as +1 or -1 in the FeedbackRow rating column
